newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine Sept inflation 2.0 pct vs 5.7 pct in Aug.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine Sept inflation 2.0 pct vs 5.7 pct in Aug.

text.p: Ukraine's monthly inflation rate for September, the month when the new hryvnia currency was introduced, slowed to 2.0 percent in September from 5.7 percent in August, the Statistics Ministry said on Monday.
UKRAINE CONSUMERS PRICES SEPT 96 AUG 96 SEPT 95

Government officials had predicted inflation in September to be four percent, in anticipation of an inflation spike up after the government introduced the hryvnia and phased out the interim karbovanets currency last month.
Ukraine's inflation rate rose sharply in August to 5.7 percent after the government increased utility rates and rents. The country achieved record-low levels of 0.1 percent in June and July.
The government forecast for annual inflation in 1996 stands at 48 percent, down from 182 percent in 1995.
The draft budget, submitted to parliament for approval last month, forecast annual inflation at 25 percent in 1997.
